earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 a3q26msearningsrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Morgan Stanley Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results Morgan Stanley Reports Net Revenues of $20.3 Billion, EPS of $3.03 and ROTCE of 22.6% NEW YORK, October 14, 2026 – Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) today reported net revenues of $20.3 billion for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared with $18.2 billion a year ago. Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $4.9 billion, or $3.03 per diluted share, compared with $4.6 billion, or $2.80 per diluted share, for the same period a year ago. 1 Ted Pick, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, said, “Morgan Stanley reported another strong quarter with net revenues of $20.3 billion, EPS of $3.03 and a ROTCE of 22.6%. The Integrated Firm is connecting the full breadth of Morgan Stanley to deliver differentiated solutions and advice for our clients. Institutional Securities benefited from global strength, led by our Equity franchise, and Wealth Management reported record revenues and added $232 billion in net new assets and $80 billion in fee-based flows. Across Wealth and Investment Management, total client assets grew to $10.5 trillion, demonstrating the scale of our platform and the strength of our franchise. We continue to invest for growth while delivering strong returns for shareholders.” Financial Summary 2,3 Firm ($ millions, except per share data) 3Q 2026 3Q 2025 Net revenues $20,338 $18,224 Pre-tax income was $3.5 billion compared with $3.2 billion a year ago. 4 Investment Banking net revenues up 2%: • Advisory revenues increased from a year ago on higher completed M&A activity in the Americas. • Equity underwriting revenues decreased from a year ago on lower IPOs and blocks, partially offset by higher follow-on offerings. • Fixed income underwriting revenues were modestly lower than the prior year period reflecting continued strength in investment grade and non-investment grade issuances. Equity net revenues up 41%: • Equity net revenues increased on strong performance across businesses and regions driven by client engagement and strength in Asia. Fixed Income net revenues down 7%: • Fixed Income net revenues decreased from a year ago primarily due to declines in credit on lower performance in securitized products and in commodities on lower structured activity. Other: • Other net revenues decreased from a year ago primarily due to higher funding costs, partially offset by lower mark-to-market losses on corporate loans, inclusive of hedges. reference.summary: Morgan Stanley, a financial holding company, provides various financial products and services to corporations, governments, financial institutions, and individuals in the Americas, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through Institutional Securities, Wealth Management, and Investment Management segments. The company offers capital raising and financial advisory services, including services related to the underwriting of debt, equity securities, and other products, as well as advice on mergers and acquisitions, restructurings, and project finance.
